name: humanpost
description: Create social content drafts, queue approved posts, and track publishing with HumanPost.

interface.longDescription: Connect AI assistants to your HumanPost workspace to inspect accounts, prepare drafts, queue approved content, and track human posting and analytics. Requires a HumanPost account and a scoped company API key. Writes can consume credits or publish content; only perform them when requested. Remote MCP currently uses API-key authentication; ChatGPT public remote-MCP submission requires additional authentication support.
defaultPrompt: Show my HumanPost social accounts and posting queues.
Prepare a HumanPost draft for my review.
